card.fires_on: The pole responds to a closing or middle piece of a proper name or brand name, such as the 'ron' in mirabegron, the 'IK' in BIKTARVY, or the 'ton' in Breton or Britton. It is strongest when the name is split into several pieces.

modes.label: Mirabegron ending
modes.description: The final piece 'ron' of the drug name mirabegron in label text.
modes.example: After reconstitution with 100 mL water, the suspension contains 8 mg/mL of mirabeg<<ron>>.

modes.label: Brand name middle
modes.description: The middle piece of a split brand or project name, such as BIKTARVY or BREEAM.

modes.label: Surname ending
modes.description: The ending 'ton' of a surname like Breton or Britton.
